analogy.rationale: DNA-PK (PRKDC) is a PI3K-related kinase central to non-homologous end joining, so its inhibition causes DNA damage-response and repair-deficiency transcriptional signatures that overlap most with other DNA-damage/repair-targeting classes. Because DNA-PK inhibition alone does not directly damage DNA, the response is expected to be moderate rather than strong.
